name: Sign-In Unable
description: Presents alternate authentication and recovery choices when password sign-in cannot continue.

conformance.notes: The canonical route contract requires a CommonLinks projection, but the existing reconciliation notes state that CommonLinks does not currently define this route.
Angular registers the canonical sign-in outcome route and binds it to SigninUnableComponent.

Expo Router now exposes the canonical route, but AuthOutcomeScreen still keys its outcome definition by the legacy /auth/continue/email/unable pathname. The canonical route exists but the view binding still needs normalization.

notes: The legacy /auth/continue/email/unable path may remain as a compatibility alias after the canonical route is fully bound.
